description: REZ-DE-CHAUSSEE ACTIF is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Nouméa. Couche des Rez-de-chaussées actifs: Données regroupant l'ensemble des rez-de-chaussées actifs. Les prescriptions règlementaires applicables à ces linéaires sont déterminées dans le présent règlement à l’article 17 des dispositions communes à toutes les zones. Elles prévalent sur les articles 1 et 2 des différentes zones. Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Territory Development, Infrastructure, Territory. Its keywords are PUD, Plan d'Urbanisme Directeur, 2020, Rez de chaussée actif, RDC ACTIF, RDC. The portal shows 2023-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
